about: One Oracle synth track with the default patch playing C4 at 0.0-0.5 s and G4 at 1.0-1.5 s, 120 BPM (synth-engine-01: offline the engine schedules against ctx.currentTime and wall-clock timers).
model: live AudioContext at 48000 Hz (forced), Return A reverb IR decoded at that rate; render = renderProject({ range: 'project', sampleRate: 48000 }); export = exportProjectAudio({ format: 'wav', range: 'project' })
facts: an EffectChain with every effect off delays the signal 8.67 ms; a track passes its own chain and the mastering chain (a send also its return's), so every onset lands about twice that late

Lead (oracle-synth) renders differently from run to run (synth-engine-01: Oracle voices are freed by wall-clock timers while the offline render runs faster than real time, so which notes sound, and where their releases are cut, depends on how fast the machine renders); this mix is compared on its status, rate and length only

File > Export Audio (WAV) fails on a 48000 Hz device: NotSupportedError: Failed to set the 'buffer' property on 'ConvolverNode': The buffer sample rate of 48000 does not match the context rate of 44100 Hz.
Tone's global context is left on the dead offline context afterwards
after the export, Play no longer moves the playhead (2 s from bar 1): live playback is broken until a reload

note 2 (G4) sounds from 1.0 s (plus the chains latency): true
